description: This PHP source file defines the ElasticSearchClientBuilder class, which provides methods to configure and build an Elasticsearch client, including loading configurations, sanitizing hosts, and handling external dependencies.

classes.name: ElasticSearchClientBuilder
classes.description: Class responsible for generating a preconfigured Elasticsearch client, managing hosts configuration, and ensuring valid connection details.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a preconfigured Elasticsearch client instance, initializing the hosts configuration if needed.

methods.name: sanitizeHost
methods.description: Validates and standardizes host configuration inputs, ensuring proper URL format and protocols.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads host configurations from a JSON file, falling back to default if file is absent or invalid.

methods.name: loadFromArray
methods.description: Sanitizes and processes an array of host configurations.

methods.name: loadFromSugarConfig
methods.description: Retrieves Elasticsearch configuration settings from the global $sugar_config variable and sanitizes the host information.

methods.name: loadDefaultConfig
methods.description: Provides default host configuration, typically localhost.

methods.name: addHttp
methods.description: Ensures a URL has an HTTP or HTTPS scheme, adding 'http://' if missing.
